data.name: Disaster City: Magical Girl Dispatch
data.detailed_description:
Welcome to "Tianyuan Metropolis" —

In a world that could blow up into pieces at any given second, this is the only city that gives you a kiss before you kick the bucket.

Fifteen years ago, the "Great Contraction Strategy" crammed tens of millions of souls into this colossal pressure cooker.

The night sky here glows an insomniac shade of violet, eight gigantic furnaces roar like forgotten stovetops day and night, and multidimensional rifts constantly spew out swarms of armored, tentacled monstrosities. And the ones blowing those beasts into paste to high-octane beats? Those are the "Star-Energy Magical Girls."

In this city, the finest delights and foulest sins rub shoulders on the same block — desire and death are next-door neighbors, separated only by razor-thin drywall.

In this brutal melting pot, your legend has just begun...

----------------------------------------

◆ Key Gameplay Features ◆

[ Stroll Through Tianyuan · Immersive Urban Exploration & Vignettes ]

Wander across intricate hive districts, neon-lit alleyways, maid cafes, and quarantined disaster sectors. Freely traverse the nodal grid map, scavenge hidden supply crates, and trigger unpredictable random events filled with dark humor, gritty reality, and eccentric romance.

[ Form Your Squad · Recruit Companions & Collect Unique "Perks" ]

Feeling as fragile as a freshly fried shrimp chip? Go rub shoulders with the city's greatest underground masters! Encounter quirky magical girls, disguised urban legends, and eccentric outcasts. Through interaction, shared perils, and battle, unlock hundreds of unique Perks and Personality Tags to forge your own tactical combat build!

[ Deep Modular Paper-Doll Customization · Awaken Magical Transformations ]

Extensive layered wardrobe and paper-doll system with multi-slot equipment and body variant options. As you awaken the dormant power of the Black Star Diamond, shatter the limits of human flesh to unlock dazzling Magical Girl Transformations — unleashing explosive stat boosts and full-screen ultimate cinematics!

[ Tactical ATB Turn-Based Combat · Obliterate Rift Horrors ]

Face chitinous, bone-armored, and tentacled rift abominations in tactical Active Time Battle (ATB) showdowns. Exploit elemental affinities, trigger skill combos, inflict status effects, and leverage environmental advantages to crush every looming catastrophe!

[ Fully Unlocked Built-in Visual Story & MOD Editor ]

Don't just experience the story — create the universe! The game comes packed with a comprehensive in-game creator suite:

· Visual Node Event Graph Editor: Drag, drop, and link nodes to create branching story trees, dice checks, and custom endings!

· Character & Paper-Doll Blueprint Editor: Customize unique characters, adjust sprite layers, and configure attribute loadouts.

· Perk / Tag / Skill / Map Customization: Build your very own custom urban legends and scenarios with complete creative freedom!

----------------------------------------

"Hehe~ The more people you bond with, the more tricks you'll master. Fifty-Five is watching you~"

— The siren is wailing, the transformation is primed. It's time to begin your journey!

Character Age Notice:

All characters depicted in this game are 18 years of age or older.

data.short_description: Disaster City: Magical Girl Dispatch is an anime RPG combining urban wasteland exploration, companion collection, paper-doll progression, and ATB turn-based combat. Explore the high-pressure city of Tianyuan, collect perks, awaken magical transformations, and craft stories in the built-in editor!
